ncm_reference: Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), Stanford Hazy Research 2026-10-12 (Kumbong, Khare, Arora, Mirhoseini, Re), arXiv 2610.14162: text as a coarse-to-fine hierarchy of discrete codes; generation proceeds level by level, predicting ALL codes within each level in parallel; few parallel steps instead of autoregression
user_theory: combine NCM-type coarse-to-fine parallel generation with our PBCS genius weights: generate multiple complete candidate answers in ONE go, then reason over the generated answer set and select the best one

mapping_to_ncm.level0_concepts: candidate solution skeletons (op multisets) = classifier top-3 + kNN-5 chains (<=8), generated in parallel - the coarse concepts
mapping_to_ncm.level1_ordering: all orderings of each multiset (the chain level), ranked by order prior
mapping_to_ncm.level2_fine_detail: operand grounding moves (op, operand-pair) are now SCORED and generated by fused memory pull + genius fine-level weights - the fine codes of NCM; genius weights decide WHICH numbers, not just which ops
mapping_to_ncm.one_go_generation: all chains x top groundings execute in ONE parallel pass producing the full candidate answer set
mapping_to_ncm.reason_and_select: selector scores every candidate VALUE from the full set in one pass and picks the best

data.train: gsm8k train subset frozen in scripts/realbench/prereg.json (indices, n=1000)
data.eval_hle: HLE full pool 2370; T2-full = gold parses as int -> 572 rows; plus v1 T2 (56)

mining_rules_v3.chains: identical 561 single-op chains from the 1000 solved problems
new_fine_level_features_mined_from_train: per-step operand role: for each annotation step t, operand kind (question text number at position i / intermediate result / literal-not-in-question) - counts -> Laplace-smoothed role priors P(kind,pos | t)
per-op magnitude ratio bands: log(va/vb) quantiles [q10,q90] for each op from train annotations

fine_level_scoring_frozen.memory_pull: mem(move | step t) = sum_n cos_n * kind_match * exp(-|d_log_ratio|/1.0) * exp(-|d_pos|/2.0) / sum_n cos_n[len_n>t] over kNN-10 neighbor chains: compares move operand KINDS, magnitude log-ratio and text-number POSITION against neighbor chains' per-step operand features - transfers across different stories/numbers (v2 lesson: raw value matching does not transfer)
fine_level_scoring_frozen.genius_pull: g_pos (role prior P(kind,pos|t), Laplace 0.5) * g_mag (1.0 if log-ratio in op's train band else 0.5) * g_prov (1.0 text numbers, 0.7 injected constants) * g_int (1.0 if uses intermediate at t>0 or t=0, else 0.8)
fine_level_scoring_frozen.caps: groundings ranked by fused score; cap 128 per chain (v1 depth restored on scored groundings), 1024 drafts/item

selector_rules_frozen.vote_weight_normalization: per-source-type RANK normalization to [0,1] BEFORE mixing (fixes v2 measured scale confound: classifier probs 0.05-0.4 vs cosines 0.6-0.9); chain plausibility also rank-normalized the same way
selector_rules_frozen.candidate_score: score(value) = sum over drafts reaching value of w_src * (1.0 if in per-skeleton band [q10,q90] else 0.5); skeleton plausibility folded into w_src
selector_rules_frozen.consensus_strict: value with >=2 DISTINCT (chain, operand-signature) paths AND max candidate score; tie -> more distinct sigs, then first rank
selector_rules_frozen.loose: top-scored valid candidate regardless of consensus (diagnostic)
selector_rules_frozen.selector_oracle_diagnostics: fraction of items where gold is among valid candidate values (= generation upper bound) and among top-5 scored candidates (selection upper bound)

success_criteria_frozen.primary_gsm8k_full_strict: PASS if acc_strict >= 0.035 (v1 loose level); PARTIAL if > 0.0235 (v1 strict); HONEST NEGATIVE if <= 0.0235
success_criteria_frozen.selection_upgrade_check: acc_loose (top-scored candidate) must exceed v2's 0.03336; acc_when_consensus must exceed v1's 0.02620
success_criteria_frozen.oracle_check: report generation upper bound vs selection accuracy gap
success_criteria_frozen.reporting_rule: whichever outcome occurs, real numbers reported; no post-hoc criterion changes

run_integrity.wall_budget: foreground 460s slices, checkpoint/resume, no background processes
